material_news_signals.headline: Rams' Puka Nacua doubtful to play Sunday night vs. Broncos
material_news_signals.description: Puka Nacua has a doubtful designation for the Rams’ Week 3 Sunday night tilt against the host Broncos. He missed L.A.'s Week 2 win with a groin injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: sean mcvay said wednesday that the los angeles rams would err on the side of caution with puka nacua s health that cautious approach has equated to nacua drawing a doubtful designation for the rams week 3 sunday night tilt against the host denver broncos a non participant in practice through the week nacua is slated to miss his second straight game dealing with what s been listed as a hip injury but mcvay characterized as a groin issue the rams coach said earlier in the week the ailment is not a long term concern and on friday the rams coach told reporters that barring a setback nacua should be able to play in l a s week 4 game against the eagles one of the game s preeminent wide receivers nacua was sidelined for six games in 2024 and one in 2025 in the rams 27 7 season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in australia nacua was los angeles leading receiver with five receptions for 74 yards in the two time pro bowler s absence during l a s 28 6 victory over the new york giants davante adams exploded for 195 yards and a pair of touchdowns on eight catches expecting adams to have back to back blockbusters especially against a staunch broncos defense is likely foolhardy if nacua is to miss sunday bigger contributions will be needed from fellow receivers jordan whittington xavier smith konata mumpfield and tutu atwell it s a rather shallow rams wr corps in which adams and nacua are the only wideouts with more than one catch through two games more likely is quarterback matthew stafford relying on his bevy of tight ends such as terrance ferguson colby parkinson and tyler higbee los angeles is 3 4 in three plus seasons when nacua doesn t play the rams kick off against the broncos on sunday night at 8 20 p m et

material_news_signals.body_text: new orleans a preseason knee surgery delayed the debut of brock bowers in klint kubiak 39 s offense the las vegas raiders tight end made up for lost time upon his return bowers was the star of the team 39 s 35 27 road victory over the new orleans saints on sunday as his 10 catches for 116 yards led all players bowers 39 production was also timely and his final reception proved to be the game 39 s biggest a 4 yard touchdown from quarterback kirk cousins to provide las vegas with some breathing room with 6 minutes 22 seconds to play 34 brock has always been a guy that we count on but to come off an injury and play the way he did was very very impressive 34 kubiak said 34 and we needed it we 39 re not surprised by that with brock 34 bowers underwent a thought it would go away at the start of the season but no just had to get it done before the long stretch of the season glad to be back 34 bowers said the knee feels healthy now and that showed in with bowers back there was no question of who would be the focal point cousins went to bowers on the team 39 s first offensive play connecting on an out route from a receiver alignment for an 8 yard the day 34 he was a big part of the game plan 34 cousins said of bowers 34 he 39 s a great player and it was good to have him back 34 bowers 39 usage tapered off some after a torrid start but he arose in big moments needing to convert a third and 14 as the raiders drove down the field at the end of the first half cousins targeted bowers on a corner route that was blanketed by jonas sanker yet as the saints safety pushed bowers to the sideline the tight end hauled in the ball around sanker while keeping his balance and his feet in bounds the catch was one of five third downs bowers converted material_news_signals.headline: Bears' Tyson Bagent clears concussion protocol ahead of Monday's game vs. Eagles; Caleb Williams out
material_news_signals.description: Bears backup quarterback Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol and will practice Saturday ahead of Chicago's Monday night game against the Eagles, head coach Ben Johnson said.
material_news_signals.body_text: the bears officially have a couple options at quarterback ahead of their monday night showdown with the eagles backup qb tyson bagent who on saturday was listed as questionable to play cleared concussion protocol on sunday and was removed from the injury report bagent progressed through protocol enough to practice in full during chicago s final practice of the week after missing the previous two sessions nfl network insider ian rapoport and espn s adam schefter reported that while ben johnson initially described bagent to reporters saturday morning as having cleared concussion protocol bagent actually progressed to the next step in the process which allowed him to practice after being symptom free into sunday bagent is in the clear though chicago hasn t named a starter with caleb williams ruled out due to a hamstring injury case keenum is also available and took starting snaps at the beginning of chicago s practice week with williams and bagent sidelined should the bears deem bagent is prepared enough to get the start it would be his first since the 2023 campaign when as an undrafted rookie he went 2 2 for the bears with 859 passing yards three touchdowns and six interceptions across five total appearances he also came in for williams on sunday against the vikings and went 5 of 9 for 54 yards during two fourth quarter possessions if the bears were to turn to keenum the 38 year old veteran would similarly be making his first start since 2023 he went 1 1 that season for the texans throwing for 291 yards one touchdown and three interceptions in what amounted to two of his four starts this decade regardless of who starts they ll have their work cut out for them against a philly defense that ranks fifth in the nfl against the pass through two weeks chicago measures up much better in the run game as the bears enter week 3 sporting the top rushing offense they ll likely look to attack the eagles 23rd ranked run defense on the ground with d 39 andre swift and kyle monangai however the passing game will still have a plethora of difference makers available in colston loveland rome odunze and luther burden as well as swift and monangai on shorter area targets we ll see what johnson draws up when the bears kick off against the eagles on monday at 8 15 p m et

material_news_signals.headline: Jayden Daniels (elbow) won't be placed on IR; Commanders GM says surgery 'not on the table'
material_news_signals.description: Washington Commanders general manager Adam Peters took an optimistic stance on Jayden Daniels’ recovery from his latest elbow injury.
material_news_signals.body_text: the commanders took an optimistic stance friday on jayden daniels recovery from his latest elbow injury as of right now surgery is not on the table and we haven t discussed injured reserve general manager adam peters said friday morning on the sports junkies on 106 7 the fan radio so it s just a matter of how we re going to get him back on the field that s still to be determined the most notable part of peters comment was that washington doesn t view ir as an option right now meaning the club expects the quarterback back sooner than a four week absence that would be required if he goes on ir coach dan quinn confirmed later friday that daniels will not be placed on ir as peters indicated the former offensive rookie of the year is considered week to week after undergoing imaging and consulting with multiple specialists about the injury to gain clarity on the extent of his absence like most things when you want to wait it out you go through the what ifs in your head and sometimes those are worse than the actual news quinn said what a great bit of news for him and for us daniels went down at the end of the first half of sunday s loss to dallas after a lineman stepped on him the qb tried to brace his fall with his non throwing arm which bent awkwardly daniels was later diagnosed with a dislocated elbow last year daniels season was also knocked off kilter and eventually ended by injuries to the same elbow peters comments don t provide a clear timeline for daniels returning to the field quinn said on monday that the expectation is marcus mariota will start sunday against seattle however with daniels not expected to land on ir there is a shot the qb returns in the next few weeks washington plays indianapolis in london in week 4 hosts the new york giants in week 5 and travels to san francisco to face the 49ers in prime time in week 6 before a bye

material_news_signals.headline: Drake Maye is falling apart and it's not clear where the Patriots go from here
material_news_signals.body_text: jacksonville fla drake maye stood alone on the sunny sideline here by this point in the fourth quarter already benched for tommy devito his hands were on his shoulder pads and he stared into the distance the stadium was mostly empty a 35 6 beatdown by the jaguars in its final stages and maye looked like he wanted to be anywhere else two weeks ago maye played the worst game of his nfl career in the season opener a super bowl rematch that fell flat again now before october has even arrived maye was left to reflect on another new low and a new worst game this one thanks to two interceptions and two fumbles would feel like rock bottom except it 39 s not clear how things are going to get better the patriots head to buffalo next week wide receiver a j brown is out at least a couple more weeks injuries are piling up on the offensive line they can 39 t run the ball and now the player who was the patriots 39 biggest source of optimism is suddenly their biggest concern 34 just unacceptable 34 maye called sunday 39 s performance when it an old fashioned butt whipping as safety kevin byard described it was finally over maye jogged off the field just around the corner and out of sight from lurking cameras patriots coach mike vrabel was waiting he gave maye a pat on the chest but maye didn 39 t break stride on his way into the locker room when he finally re emerged maye shook his head in disbelief at where the patriots are not just 1 2 which would 39 ve been fine after a tough open to the schedule but playing like a team without answers 34 ball starts rolling like that and we can 39 t get out of our own way i can 39 t get out of my own way 34 maye said 34 i 39 ve got to look at myself in the mirror 34 there 39 s so much that seems wrong with maye right now and so few answers for how it 39 ll get better but it seems important to start here maye 39 s confidence seems shot a year ago when vrabel inherited a mess of a situation one of the most important things he did was re instill a belief within his young quarterback he talked about maye 39 s strengths he stressed the importance of celebrating with teammates and talked to maye about how to lead a football team maye went on to be the league 39 s mvp runner up to los angeles rams quarterback matthew stafford now that seems like a distant memory maye doesn 39 t look anything like the quarterback of a year ago who totaled 31 touchdowns to eight interceptions this season he 39 s thrown for one score and been picked off six times his swagger is gone a year ago in the afc championship game maye didn 39 t tell any of his teammates his plan in the huddle when he bolted on a third down naked bootleg to send the patriots to the super bowl now that same quarterback is floating easily intercepted passes in the final seconds of the first half off his back foot to a 5 foot 10 wide receiver leaving the patriots 39 sideline befuddled after travis hunter 39 s pick and somehow that wasn 39 t even maye 39 s craziest turnover sunday at one point he reached back to throw the kind of deep ball that was so often caught last season and the ball almost comically coughed out of his hands he said that was partly because center jared wilson had a cut on his finger and blood was on the ball and maybe that was why it slipped out 34 you could say that but at the same time i 39 ve got to hold onto the football 34 maye said a slow start from maye would 39 ve been totally understandable some level of regression was expected but it was never supposed to look like this it was never supposed to get to the point where the patriots weren 39 t just losing but losing because of maye and what makes things tougher is it 39 s not clear how this gets better the patriots need a deep threat maye was arguably the league 39 s best deep ball passer a year ago the thought was that adding brown would force defenses to play back against the pats and open things up underneath but they traded their best deep threat wide receiver kayshon boutte just before the season because they felt they didn 39 t need him with brown in the fold then brown suffered an ankle injury in the first game and will be out at least two more weeks without him the patriots don 39 t have any answers mack hollins who picked up a taunting penalty while his team trailed 28 3 is playing like the team 39 s best wide receiver which is great for hollins but not a great sign for the team romeo doubs isn 39 t playing like a 17 million player kyle williams was blanketed in coverage on what ended up as maye 39 s second interception and the offense remains totally unable to run the ball so if it 39 s going to get better it 39 s likely going to have to be maye pulling himself and the patriots out of this mess but that seems awfully difficult considering his decision making of late has resulted in seven turnovers through three games 34 we haven 39 t made good decisions with the football 34 vrabel said maye isn 39 t in the same territory as mac jones was at the end of his patriots tenure but this game felt a bit like the one in germany in 2023 when every time jones dropped back it felt like a mistake was around the corner and what a shocking place that is for maye after last year to be fumbling from a clean pocket to be handing the other team easy interceptions at crucial moments to suddenly have questions about whether last year was a mirage and whether maye really is the guy afterward they all said the right things maye took ownership teammates backed their quarterback vrabel vowed that he 39 d work extra hard to improve the team but alarm bells have sounded maye 39 s slump isn 39 t a blip his struggles are obvious and concern is mounting surely you 39 d think this is rock out of it he said i haven t really given it too much thought at this point last year flacco wasn t aware he was being traded from cleveland to cincinnati so anything can happen but there is minuscule material_news_signals.body_text: new orleans a preseason knee surgery delayed the debut of brock bowers in klint kubiak 39 s offense the las vegas raiders tight end made up for lost time upon his return bowers was the star of the team 39 s 35 27 road victory over the new orleans saints on sunday as his 10 catches for 116 yards led all players bowers 39 production was also timely and his final reception proved to be the game 39 s biggest a 4 yard touchdown from quarterback kirk cousins to provide las vegas with some breathing room with 6 minutes 22 seconds to play 34 brock has always been a guy that we count on but to come off an injury and play the way he did was very very impressive 34 kubiak said 34 and we needed it we 39 re not surprised by that with brock 34 bowers underwent a procedure to 34 clean up 34 his knee ahead of the raiders 39 season opener though kubiak expressed optimism about his status the tight end ultimately missed the raiders 39 first two games bowers said sunday having surgery was 34 tough 34 as he initially didn 39 t perceive his pain to be an issue despite its nagging through training camp 34 i thought it was kind of nothing 34 bowers said 34 i thought it would go away at the start of the season but no just had to get it done before the long stretch of the season glad to be back 34 bowers said the knee feels healthy now and that showed in his 2026 debut he had no trouble separating from saints defenders breaking precisely to get open his speed wasn 39 t lacking either nbsp evidenced by his 29 yards after the catch glimpses of what bowers could be with kubiak as his play caller showed during training camp despite his ailing knee the coach schemed up his star perfectly as bowers had an explosive play or touchdown in nearly every practice those opportunities were spread out during the raiders 39 2 0 start with tight end michael mayer and the team 39 s stable of receivers earning nearly equal opportunities across both wins but with bowers back there was no question of who would be the focal point cousins went to bowers on the team 39 s first offensive play connecting on an out route from a receiver alignment for an 8 yard gain the veteran found bowers twice more on their opening drive and his 37 yards set up a matt gay field goal for the game 39 s opening score his early involvement foretold the raiders 39 strategy for the day 34 he was a big part of the game plan 34 cousins said of bowers 34 he 39 s a great player and it was good to have him back 34 bowers 39 usage tapered off some after a torrid start but he arose in big moments needing to convert a third and 14 as the raiders drove down the field at the end of the first half cousins targeted bowers on a corner route that was blanketed by jonas sanker yet as the saints safety pushed bowers to the sideline the tight end hauled in the ball around sanker while keeping his balance and his feet in bounds the catch was one of five third downs bowers converted on the day and it set up another gay field goal to give las vegas a 16 13 advantage at the break the completion 39 s improbability was representative of the chemistry cousins and bowers share such was evident in practices but the quarterback was pleased to see it translate when it mattered 34 i had this with minnesota vikings wide receiver justin jefferson where early on you don 39 t realize how good he was as a player 34 cousins said 34 and then you play with him longer and you start to realize 39 oh practice didn 39 t really show just how good he is 39 and so i think games with brock will be important for us to continue to build that rapport 34 after the saints put up two touchdowns early in the third quarter another long bowers conversion helped the raiders rebuild momentum a touchdown run by rookie mike washington followed two plays later having taken a 28 27 lead on a touchdown from wide receiver cody white early in the fourth quarter bowers delivered valuable insurance in their first two games the raiders got the job done but their successes weren 39 t consistent kubiak was pleased with the results but he knew something was missing 34 our guys won those first two games when he wasn 39 t there 34 kubiak said 34 the team finds a way to win that 39 s what good teams do 34 with bowers back kubiak won 39 t need to find other ways the tight end showed sunday he can be the difference maker for his coach bowers 39 leading the offense gives the raiders an engine they can depend on the kind built to power them throughout the season this article originally appeared guy that we count on but to come off an injury and play the way he did was very very impressive 34 kubiak said 34 and we needed it we 39 re not surprised by that with brock 34 bowers underwent a thought it would go away at the start of the season but no just had to get it done before the long stretch of the season glad to be back 34 bowers said the knee feels healthy now and that showed in his 2026 debut he had no trouble separating from saints defenders breaking precisely to get open his speed wasn 39 t lacking either nbsp evidenced by his 29 yards after the catch glimpses of what in big moments needing to convert a third and 14 as the raiders drove down the field at the end of the first half cousins targeted bowers on a corner route that was blanketed by jonas sanker yet as the saints safety pushed bowers to the sideline the tight end hauled in the ball around sanker while keeping his balance and his feet in bounds the catch was one of five third downs bowers converted evident in practices but the quarterback was pleased to see it translate when it mattered 34 i had this with minnesota vikings wide receiver justin jefferson where early on you don 39 t realize how good he was as a player 34 cousins said 34 and then you play with him longer and you start to realize 39 oh practice didn 39 t really show just how good he is 39 and so i think games with brock will be important for us to continue to build that rapport 34 after the saints put up two touchdowns early in the third quarter another long bowers conversion helped the raiders rebuild momentum a touchdown run by rookie mike washington followed two plays later having taken a 28 27 lead on a touchdown from wide receiver cody white early in the fourth quarter bowers delivered valuable insurance
